name: PromoCta
description: v2 — dark promotional pill: app icon + eyebrow label + 32px arrow button (Figma sub-set PromoCTA/Arrow Button, 11223:211366). Always-knockout surface, theme-invariant by design. v1's xl size is retired (maps to lg).

props.name: size
props.description: v2 is lg-only; the deprecated v1 "xl" value is normalized to lg

props.name: state
props.description: Force a visual state for QA; real states come from :hover/:active

props.name: showIconEnd
props.description: Figma: Show Icon End (arrow button). v1 alias showIcon still accepted.

knownTokenGaps.note: The s2a/color/promo-cta/* family is bound in Figma (merged from elastic-card-updates) but has not shipped in a tokens release yet. Every reference fallback-chains to the shipped invariant token with the same resolved value (background-knockout, content-knockout, gray-800/700/600, gray-25). When the family ships, the first var in each chain takes over — no code change needed.

notes: Renders a real <button type="button">; the label text is the accessible name.
Focus ring uses --s2a-color-focus-ring-knockout (white) — the pill is always on a dark surface.
The arrow button is decorative (part of the same tap target), not a nested interactive element.
